title: Rich Lamb Curry
ingredients: 500g lamb neck fillet or lamb leg steaks, chopped into even chunks
1 tbsp peeled and finely grated fresh root ginger
a few mint leaves, chopped, to serve
steps: Mix yogurt, turmeric and chilli powder in a bowl; add lamb; stir. Cover and set aside.
Stir-fry onions and cumin seeds in cooking spray for 8 minutes until browned and caramelizing.
Add ginger, garlic and green chillies; stir-fry 1 minute. Add ground spices and salt; stir through.
Pour in 100ml hot water; add tomato purée; stir everything together.
Add lamb and yogurt mixture; fry 7 minutes, stirring regularly.
Pour in remaining hot water; stir well; simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
When done, sauce will be thick and rich and lamb tender. Sprinkle with mint to serve.
notes: Pairs beautifully with Golden Coconut Curry with Butternut Squash & Red Lentils (p.158).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
